arguments.heading: What happened at the argument

Justice Jackson asked why a definitive interpretation matters for the case.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This dispute defines when federal courts lose power over property claims. It shapes how long citizens can challenge government land ownership. It clarifies the scope of sovereign immunity waivers.
